paragraphs.text: SALDEV-1467 | Resolve Apex Error on Opportunity Line ID Flow
FlywirePartial | Read-only implementation review and check-only validation
The obsolete Flow removes one writer, but the replacement OLI after-insert trigger still performs cross-object DML on SBQQ__QuoteLine__c and can re-enter CPQ after-update processing.
Figure 1. SALDEV-1467 current OLI-to-Quote-Line execution path

The fix should establish identifiers before CPQ-managed after-update work, make mapping deterministic for duplicate bundle structures, surface partial DML failures, and test every lifecycle outcome explicitly.
Figure 2. SALDEV-1467 acceptance-evidence gap and required scenario matrix

Architect interpretation: the implementation is not release-ready. Passing tests show executable code, but the failed coverage gate and unchanged cross-object DML pattern leave both deployment and runtime acceptance unresolved.

This assessment uses the SALDEV-1467 ticket text, read-only FlywirePartial identity verification, scoped metadata retrieval, focused Apex tests, source inspection, and a check-only validation. No records, deployment, activation, quick deploy, or org metadata changes were performed.

cells: NO-GO - Changes Requested before QA or promotion
No records, deployment, activation, or org metadata were changed

ARCHITECT DECISION
Do not approve SALDEV-1467. The scoped package compiles and all specified tests pass, but check-only validation fails coverage gates and the replacement retains the original cross-object Quote Line DML risk from an OLI after-insert context.
Mapping logic exists, but tests prove only non-null/fallback values rather than exact cross-group identity for all bundle slots.
The amendment method is invoked, but no assertion confirms the cloned line retains the source Opportunity Line ID.
No test proves an ordinary clone receives a new Opportunity Line ID or remains independent of the source line.
Fixtures mention these contexts, but end-to-end cloning outcomes are not asserted for each lifecycle path.
Synthetic tests pass; no representative bundle test proves the CPQ async collision is eliminated.

DESIGN READING
Green is verified. Amber needs stronger evidence. Red blocks approval or can recreate the original failure mode.
0AfhG000001ZTplSAG; checkOnly=true; rollbackOnError=true; no component or test errors.
1 Flow, 3 triggers, 6 Apex classes/tests; all 10 compiled successfully.
QuoteLineTrigger 69.70%; QuoteLineGroupAsyncHelper 7.69%; each selected component requires at least 75%.
QuoteLineTrigger has 33 executable locations with 10 uncovered; helper has 13 with 12 uncovered.
OLI after insert calls Database.update on Quote Lines, re-entering the managed SBQQ after-update lifecycle.
Database.update(..., false) SaveResults are ignored; guard reset is not protected by finally.
When relationship data is absent, processOliIdSync(List) adds Quote Line IDs to the quote-ID set; its test asserts only true.
Before-insert mapping keys only quote plus product and uses ordered slots; repeated products in multiple bundles can be ambiguous.
copyOpportunityLineIdOnRamp catches all exceptions and only debugs, allowing quoting to continue with missing IDs.
No exact ID equality/inequality assertions for price-change clones, ordinary clones, and all New/Amend/Renew paths.
The ticket says part of SALDEV-1427 is covered, but the promoted component/test boundary and ownership are not defined.
Redesign the OLI-to-Quote-Line sync so the fix does not issue Quote Line DML from OLI after insert in the CPQ transaction.
Raise QuoteLineTrigger and QuoteLineGroupAsyncHelper to at least 75% in the exact deployment payload.
Add exact same-ID and new-ID assertions for stepped, price-change, and ordinary clones across New, Amend, and Renew.
Run representative large bundles and confirm no AsyncException, recursion, SOQL 101, or silent SaveResult failures.
Document which ramp-ID behavior belongs to SALDEV-1467 versus SALDEV-1427 and deploy/test them as one controlled dependency set.
Require a clean 10/10 check-only result, then execute named New/Amend/Renew scenarios with field-level evidence.

STORY COMMENT
Architect review completed for SALDEV-1467 in FlywirePartial. Changes Requested / NO-GO. The original Flow is Obsolete and the scoped Apex compiles, but check-only job 0AfhG000001ZTplSAG failed: all 10 components compiled and all 16 specified test methods passed, yet QuoteLineTrigger is only 69.70% covered and QuoteLineGroupAsyncHelper is 7.69%, below the 75% requirement. More importantly, FWOpportunityLineItemTrigger still runs after insert and OpportunityLineItemTriggerHandler performs Database.update on SBQQ__QuoteLine__c, so the replacement retains the same CPQ after-update re-entry pattern implicated in the original AsyncException. SaveResults are not inspected, one fallback path treats a Quote Line ID as a Quote ID, and the tests do not assert the required same-ID/new-ID outcomes across New, Amendment, and Renewal cloning. Redesign the cross-object sync, fix coverage, add exact lifecycle assertions, clarify the SALDEV-1427 dependency, and repeat check-only plus representative CPQ bundle QA before approval.
